scope: Minimal full-shape components supporting complete requested model/design/RTL/synthesis/route work

baseline_commands.scope: Existing HBM tile baseline only; does not validate new ROM provider

new_runner_status: New ROM wrapper bench and gate must bind cases after selected analytical geometry exists; this plan does not assert those commands already implemented.
run_manifest_required: golden digest and explicit arithmetic/fusion settings
checkpoint extracted payload hashes and original ranges
execution_policy: No heavy local jobs; guarded remote clean pinned worktree runs after model build readiness.
Reserve measured CPU/RAM/disk; no arbitrary wall-time/address-space/file-size caps.
Reuse valid running jobs; preserve compiler objects and failed evidence.
One mechanism at full selected shape; do not use a reduced pilot to claim throughput/area closure.

cases.minimum_vehicle: Unified uarch model plus checkpoint inventory
cases.inputs: Selected cluster parameters, all AR tensor mappings, memory macro abstracts, finite port inventory, topology and decode DAG
pass_predicates: Every mandatory AR tensor including embedding, head, Engram, scales, configuration and derived tables has capacity and reachable placement; vision/MTP scope explicit.
MAC/cycle by precision, bytes/cycle every port, bits/cycle every boundary, routing tracks/capacity, replicas/mux/fanout, area/slot fit and composed single-user latency all priced.
Per-operation active resources respect row/tile/pair mapping, exclusive compute modes, NC1 semantics and finite outstanding queues.
Die count/topology derived from simultaneous capacity, area, power, routing and service constraints; total silicon includes HBM DRAM dies.
Nominal and conservative missing-evidence assumptions tagged; no zero-cost unmeasured delivery or reuse.
Selected candidate and rejected candidates retained with objective and constraints.
cases.failure_policy: Preserve immutable failed run; no adoption credit; correct model or reject measured-slower/nonclosing lever rather than tune it into a claimed gain.

cases.minimum_vehicle: One selected physical cluster and its addressed ROM regions
cases.inputs: Real checkpoint byte ranges, scales, row/K geometry and mapping manifest
pass_predicates: Hash actual extracted bytes, record shard identity/ranges and header/index hashes; header hashes alone do not authenticate payload.
Independent decoder reconstructs logical weight coordinates and verifies exact bytes/scales before arithmetic.
Every simulated weight comes through DUT ROM request/capture/mux/response path; no testbench result injection or already-decoded weight bypass.
No ROM ECC/parity-only sidecars introduced; mutable-state protection and descriptor/address/transaction checks retained.
cases.failure_policy: Preserve immutable failed run; no adoption credit; correct model or reject measured-slower/nonclosing lever rather than tune it into a claimed gain.

cases.claim_scope: Quantized full-K exactness and tile service
cases.minimum_vehicle: One full selected compute tile with physical sharing-bank count
cases.inputs: Released FP4 routed gate/up/down and FP8 dense/a_proj shards; full logical K and every output row resident in selected tile
pass_predicates: Explicit HDC_V41_ARITH=chunk8 and empty HDC_V41_FUSE unless separately approved; independent pinned golden computes expected outputs.
All output FP32/BF16 bits compared at specified boundary; block32 exact dot, scale and chunk8 block-sum order preserved.
Mixed-format a_proj/down decompositions cover all terms exactly once and preserve golden cross-segment order.
No reduced K or reduced row count is used to justify full-shape service, occupancy or throughput.
Record first request, first usable output, last output, arrive, release and retired cycles plus ROM/activation/output occupancy.
cases.failure_policy: Preserve immutable failed run; no adoption credit; correct model or reject measured-slower/nonclosing lever rather than tune it into a claimed gain.

cases.minimum_vehicle: One full selected BF16 tile/output group
cases.inputs: Released head and grouped wo_a rows with full logical K; exact released FP8-to-BF16 conversion for wo_a if selected
pass_predicates: Full-K original output reduction tree and rounding points retained; final tree padding explicit.
Every selected physical row checked, including partial last tile and IL8 row-count edge.
Head max comparison preserves ties and defined exceptional values; final winner is compared to independent golden across all groups in software composition.
No hidden configuration-write overlap unless hardware path and finite ports establish it.
cases.failure_policy: Preserve immutable failed run; no adoption credit; correct model or reject measured-slower/nonclosing lever rather than tune it into a claimed gain.

cases.minimum_vehicle: Smallest complete actual arithmetic lane/reducer plus representative full-K tile
cases.inputs: Independent boundary vectors: cancellation, exponent range, signed zero, quantizer halfway/ties, scale transitions, non-power-of-two chunk count, rows1/7/8/9, K/block tails where supported
pass_predicates: Compare to golden directly, not merely ENABLE0 vs ENABLE1 equivalence.
Supported tails exact; unsupported K/shape descriptors rejected before ROM access rather than silently truncated.
NaN/Inf and FP8 saturation policy matches existing contract; no new algebraic reassociation.
cases.failure_policy: Preserve immutable failed run; no adoption credit; correct model or reject measured-slower/nonclosing lever rather than tune it into a claimed gain.

cases.claim_scope: Actual compute reuse and bank service
cases.minimum_vehicle: One selected full bank-sharing cluster connected to full tile
cases.inputs: Back-to-back operations from different physical ROM banks, different experts and precision modes; retained real activation inputs
pass_predicates: Same physical compute instance reused for distinct weights without reset or free preload between operations.
Bank mux selection/capture/format conversion/phase startup and descriptor delivery included in measured latency.
Concurrent arrivals use real finite arbiter and buffers; measured service obeys bank/port inventory.
Weight lane ordering is checked at response boundary against independent address map.
cases.failure_policy: Preserve immutable failed run; no adoption credit; correct model or reject measured-slower/nonclosing lever rather than tune it into a claimed gain.

cases.minimum_vehicle: Same selected cluster with actual request/tag interface and result sink
cases.inputs: Request stalls, bounded response latency variation/reordering where permitted, burst completion, downstream stall, queue saturation, operation transition and reset
pass_predicates: The inherited1088-bit response interface has no rsp_ready; capacity reserved before issuing every irrevocable ROM response.
Inherited result interface has no ready; wrapper admits work only with sufficient sink capacity or proven always-accept service.
No lost, duplicated, stale or reordered logical row; identity and epoch checked at retirement.
Credits never negative/exceed capacity; no buffer overwritten before consumer release.
Activation visibility and complete input writes precede eligible issue; prior output/release cannot expose next operation prematurely.
Progress checked under a finite declared service bound; permanent external stall is not called deadlock.
cases.failure_policy: Preserve immutable failed run; no adoption credit; correct model or reject measured-slower/nonclosing lever rather than tune it into a claimed gain.

cases.minimum_vehicle: One tile and smallest real downstream consumer/CDC/fusion path
cases.inputs: Full-shape activation/result blocks with actual ratio3:4 CDC and finite shared resources
pass_predicates: Golden consumer receives exact values in required order and begins only when dependencies satisfied.
Clock crossings, first result visibility, last result and completion/release charged distinctly.
No whole-array simulation needed; external traffic driven from pinned analytical schedule with real finite ports.
cases.failure_policy: Preserve immutable failed run; no adoption credit; correct model or reject measured-slower/nonclosing lever rather than tune it into a claimed gain.

cases.minimum_vehicle: Synthesizable selected compute plus complete bank-select/capture/config/buffers and real memory blackboxes
cases.inputs: Same parameters/source hashes as RTL validation; selected macro inventory
pass_predicates: No blackbox arithmetic, missing modules, unintended latches, unconstrained generated clocks or synthesized-away active banks.
Macro count, SRAM ports, capture flop count and mux fanout reconcile to model.
Mapped logic plus real macro footprint/halo/routing/clock reserve fits selected slot.
Actual synthesis report retained; tools/hbm_accel_sm_v_gate.py synth is synthetic-vector simulation, NOT logic synthesis.
cases.failure_policy: Preserve immutable failed run; no adoption credit; correct model or reject measured-slower/nonclosing lever rather than tune it into a claimed gain.

cases.minimum_vehicle: One real full-shape hardened cluster with adjacent macro abstracts/corridor loads representing replication
cases.inputs: Matched synthesized netlist, real selected ROM/SRAM LEF/LIB, floorplan and boundary loads
pass_predicates: 1.2GHz streaming setup at SS, hold at FF; setup uncertainty60ps and hold25ps unchanged.
Serial-chain domain0.9GHz separately constrained; true CDC exceptions reviewed and bounded.
ROM actual clk-to-q included, two-cycle capture justified and final capture/select stage included.
Detailed-route DRC, antenna where available, congestion and actual hub routing-layer check pass; TT is pathfinding only.
Pin access, required boundary tracks, macro obstructions, fanout and neighbor corridor interference covered.
No new clock frequency headline until matched SS/FF evidence exists.
cases.failure_policy: Preserve immutable failed run; no adoption credit; correct model or reject measured-slower/nonclosing lever rather than tune it into a claimed gain.

cases.minimum_vehicle: Routed full cluster with measured activity and priced replicas
cases.inputs: Real active, idle-gated, bank-switch and wake workloads; model schedule
pass_predicates: Macro/periphery/net/clock/SRAM/compute/interface/leakage terms have explicit boundaries; no double counting.
ROM model energy assumptions kept separate from measured routed-cell activity.
Per-token energy includes all idle dies and resident KV HBM; instantaneous peak from simultaneous phase schedule.
Wake cycles and gating state enter both timing and energy; no assumed zero idle power.
Selected die thermal budget and whole-system budget met or candidate rejected.
cases.failure_policy: Preserve immutable failed run; no adoption credit; correct model or reject measured-slower/nonclosing lever rather than tune it into a claimed gain.

cases.minimum_vehicle: Analytical static DAG composed from measured minimal components
cases.inputs: Validated mapping/topology plus new cluster timings and source-pinned reused component evidence
pass_predicates: All forty layers, embedding, head, Engram, index, attention, SU, collectives and output return covered; no unknown component assigned zero.
Every DAG node binds to resident stage/die including layer=-1; topology hop counts recomputed for selected placement.
Serial dependencies, compute/ports mutual exclusion, memory startup, CDC, buffer leases and retire tails composed.
1M KV exact full-scan traffic retained unless candidate-only semantics separately proven; no free persistent-cache assumption.
Measured full-shape mechanism gain >=1% per-user rate and contextual SS/FF/hub gates required for adoption; keep opt-in disabled otherwise.
Model prediction vs measured-component composition vs integrated achieved performance labelled separately.
Whole-system simulation only as final integration smoke if owner explicitly requests; not required to characterize each mechanism.
cases.failure_policy: Preserve immutable failed run; no adoption credit; correct model or reject measured-slower/nonclosing lever rather than tune it into a claimed gain.
